page.layout: Running head at top centre; page number 213 at top right. One text column with notes in the right margin. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: Elixatio.Elixatio est indefiniti humidi concoctio ab humido calido facta.
Maturatio.Maturatio est alimenti ejus quod in arborum fructibus est, concoctio.
Assatio.Assatio est concoctio humidi interni facta a calore sicco & extraneo.
Attractrix.Attractrix est facultas ministra, alimentum conveniens per villos rectos intra corpus nutriendum attrahens & recipiens.
RetentrixRetentrix est facultas serviens nutrici, attractum nutrimentum donec alteretur per fibras obliquas conservans.
ExpultrixExpultrix est facultas ministrans nutritioni, alteratum vel secretum a partibus per villos transversos expellens.

Facultas auctrix.Auctrix facultas est animae Vegetantis vis, qua corpus animatum ex assimilato alimento nutritu in omnes dimensiones extenditur, & justam magnitudinem consequitur, ad edendas proprias & convenientes actiones.
NB. 1. Ut altricis facultatis est finis, partium consumtarum instauratio: Sic auctricis finis est acquisitio justa magnitudinis.

page.notes: The right margin notes are small italic catchwords (Elixatio, Maturatio, Assatio, Attractrix, Retentrix, Expultrix, Facultas auctrix); the hyphenated printing of "Matura-tio", "Attra-ctrix" and "Facultas auctrix" is simplified. Faint show-through of the facing page appears in the margins and is omitted. The printed "Affatio" in the margin and the text reads as Assatio (long s). Tall word "Vegetantis" and "Ut altricis" are kept as printed.
